brief.summary: Playful, thrifted-feeling eclecticism worn with intent: one loud piece (an embellished or patchwork jacket, a printed skirt, a cowboy boot) against plain, well-cut basics. Gingham, stripes and vintage-looking knits mix freely; proportions are slightly undone — a cropped flare, an oversized shirt, a shrunken cardigan — and the finish is a classic bag or a loafer so it never reads as costume.
signatures: embellished, beaded or patchwork jacket over a plain shirt
vintage-look cardigan or fair isle knit
slip skirt or printed midi with a chunky knit
one classic structured bag against the mix
ballet flats and a mini skirt for day
silhouettes: shrunken knit over a long skirt
